name: Storrev
description: An undead Golgari lich sorceress, one of Vraska's Erstwhile, who welcomes Ral and Kaya to Svogthos.

description_citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
description_citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The group enters Korozda unopposed and Storrev welcomes them to Svogthos, with Rat whispering her name to Ral.
timeline.quote: The Golgari Swarm welcomes you to Svogthos.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Azdomas says Mazirek was a Bolas collaborator revealed by Vraska and has paid the ultimate price.
timeline.quote: Mazirek was another Bolas collaborator, revealed by Queen Vraska before her departure.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska planeswalks in to claim her throne and the Golgari leaders bow to her without challenge.
timeline.quote: Madame Storrev, Mister Azdomas, Mister Varolz, and Miss Cevraya all bowed immediately, saying in unison, "No, my queen."
